name: Nasir al-Din al-Tusi
contribution: A Persian polymath, architect, philosopher, physician, scientist, and theologian, as well as a prominent Shi'ite scholar.

checks.lead: Muḥammad ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī (1201–1274; AH 598–673), commonly known as Naṣīr al-Dīn al-Ṭūsī (Arabic: نصیر الدین الطوسی; Persian: نصیر الدین طوسی) or simply (al-)Tusi, was a Persian polymath, architect, philosopher, physician, scientist, and theologian, as well as a prominent Shi'ite scholar. He wrote extensively on mathematics, engineering, prose, mysticism, philosophy, theology, and the sciences, and is widely regarded as one of the greatest scientists of medieval Islam.
